verdict.rationale: Opting out of telemetry and usage tracking is a fair privacy question for a consumer email service, so the axis applies. Nothing in the evidence pack documents any Gmail setting for telemetry, usage-tracking, or activity-data opt-out. The OAuth scope guidance is about narrowing third-party app access, which is an adjacent control and earns no credit here.

support.subject: As an AI-native user, I can opt out of telemetry and usage tracking
